planet.name: Monria
planet.summary: Monria is Virtualsense's moon, a separate space destination with a local teleporter link to DSEC-9. The core loop is a set of hunting, mining, crafting and taming dailies that pay Daily Tokens, with the long Order of the Elder Gods chain running alongside.
planet.howToReach: Shared warp: the Yamato runs from and back to Monria (6 PED per schedule for paying passengers; free for qualifying born avatars, estate owners and Toulan citizens), and Kronan lists Monria as a request stop. Arrive at Monria Space Station and use its teleporter.
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; field verification is pending.
Yamato runs were suspended in September 2026 and dates were published again in November 2026. Check the operator thread before planning a trip.
Some published NPC coordinates differ by a few units or by floor, notably Tobie and Angel. Waypoint names were set by the research notes; the cited sources show the same coordinates.
Tobie's crafting daily clock is reported as 21 h and as about 22 h. Which crafts count automatically is unconfirmed.

activities.title: Travel to Monria by shared warp
activities.summary: Monria is Virtualsense's moon, its own space destination. The usual way in is a shared warp: the Yamato runs from and back to Monria, and Kronan will stop there on request.
steps: Check the Yamato operator thread for the next run date, signup and summons close to departure.
Paying passengers pay 6 PED per schedule; qualifying born avatars, estate owners and Toulan citizens can travel free.
Or ask Kronan for a request stop at Monria.
Arrive at Monria Space Station and take the station teleporter down.
rewards: Access to Monria and, through its teleporters, DSEC-9
requirementsText: A seat on a scheduled warp (Yamato or Kronan) or your own ship
Yamato paying passengers sign up in the Virtualsense travel program thread; free travel only for Monrian/Toulan born, estate owners at Monria, DSEC9 or Toulan, and Toulan citizens
Kronan request stops must be requested before 01:25 game time

prereqInfo.note: Virtualsense: the Yamato starts and ends on Monria; paying passengers sign up and pay 6 PED; listed groups ride free. Kronan stops at Monria on request.
unknowns: Whether a Teleportation Token link to Monria exists. No official note found lists one.
Whether Yamato runs are back on their normal schedule after the September 2026 interruption (the November 2026 post lists dates again).

cost.text: 6 PED per Yamato schedule for paying passengers; free for qualifying born avatars, estate owners and Toulan citizens.

activities.limits: Runs only on scheduled dates. Usually Fridays and Sundays, moved to Thursday/Monday around Toulan event weekends.

score.rationale: Needed before anything else on Monria or DSEC-9; cost and timing depend on the warp schedule.

warnings: Yamato runs were suspended in September 2026; the November 2026 post publishes dates again. Confirm the current run, destination station and summons before relying on it.
Do not fly your own craft through lootable PvP space with valuables.

activities.title: Protect cargo and plan your way out
activities.summary: Space between planets includes lootable PvP zones. Leave lootables behind when flying yourself and know which teleport options exist before you leave.
steps: Follow the warp operator's instructions; avoid carrying lootable items on personal flights through lootable PvP space.
Ordinary station-to-own-planet teleports are free since MindArk 18.9; token travel has a 150 kg cap.
Since 19.2.0 eligible links cost 6 Teleportation Tokens station-to-station and 10 planet-to-planet.
Check the actual Monria station teleporter menu or the operator's drop instructions before buying tokens.
rewards: Fewer losses in space; a planned exit route
requirementsText: 150 kg weight cap for token teleports

cost.text: Teleportation Tokens if an eligible token link exists (6 station-to-station, 10 planet-to-planet). PED value of tokens not given.

currencies.name: Teleportation Token
currencies.note: 6 station-to-station or 10 planet-to-planet on eligible links since 19.2.0.

score.rationale: Free advice that avoids losing loot; read before the first trip.

warnings: MindArk's general patch notes do not list every moon. Whether Monria has a token link was not confirmed.

activities.title: Register Monria's hubs and teleporters
activities.summary: Find the main bases first: Monria Hub for crafting and traders, DSEC Forensics for the Shoggoth daily and the Order of the Elder Gods, then the Mining Camp, Military Camp and Shub Cavern when your gear and plans call for them.
steps: Register the Monria Hub teleporter (crafting, traders, Tobie, token traders).
Register DSEC Forensics (Sachem Ursa and Pinthas stand there).
Register DSEC Mining Camp, DSEC Military Camp and Shub Cavern as you need them.
Use the Virtualsense directory and waypoint guide for services and routes.
requirementsText: Gear to fight through the caves on foot for Shub Cavern (no vehicles or teleport chips there)

prereqInfo.note: The partner's Monria guide (2024) says DSEC Forensics is a given teleporter, the Mining and Military Camp teleporters must be collected, and the cave teleporters up to Shub Cavern are reached by fighting through on foot. Nothing else is required beyond being on Monria.

cost.text: Walking or vehicle time; no fee mentioned.

locations.label: Monria Hub (crafting and traders). Nexus lists a teleporter called '3 Hub' here; its altitude looks like a default and it is not confirmed in game.
DSEC Forensics (given to you, per the guide)

score.rationale: Sol's step 3; every daily starts from one of these hubs.

warnings: The guide PDF is from 2024 and the 2025 directory link is dead (404); waypoints may have moved.
unknowns: Exact name of the Monria Hub teleporter in game.

activities.title: The Order of the Elder Gods (Horns of Z'agol)
activities.summary: A long chain started at Pinthas. Four chapters drop, rarely, from Shoggoths, Yogs, Cultists and Shubs in that order. Completing all four gives the Horns of Z'agol, a combat item with 3% reload speed.
steps: Start the chain with Pinthas at DSEC Forensics, next to Sachem Ursa.
Hunt Shoggoths for Chapter 1, Yogs for Chapter 2, Cultists for Chapter 3 and Shubs for Chapter 4.
Run it alongside the matching hunting dailies; chapters drop independently of the daily progress.
Hand in all four chapters for the Horns.
rewards: Horns of Z'agol (3% reload speed per the operator guide)

cost.text: Ammo and decay across many hunts; chapters are rare drops.

activities.limits: Chapters are untradeable, so you have to find all four yourself.

score.rationale: Best long-term combat reward on Monria, but the rare chapter drops make it slow; start it early and let it run with the dailies.

warnings: Older posts about trading chapter copies predate the change that made chapters untradeable.
The Pinthas waypoint is attributed to the Everything Guide PDF, which this conversion could not text-check; treat it as unconfirmed.

activities.title: Toy Soldier plushie mission
activities.summary: Start Toy Soldier at the Monria Hub so the same Monria hunts also advance plushie progress.
steps: Pick up Toy Soldier at the Monria Hub.
Hunt as usual for the dailies; plushie progress fills from the same kills.

cost.text: No extra cost beyond hunts you already do.

cooldown.resetNote: Sol gives no timer or repeat rule.

score.rationale: Free extra progress from hunts you already do; reward details were not given.

warnings: Exact plushie rewards and whether it repeats were not covered in Sol's notes.

activities.title: Go to DSEC-9 through Monria's teleporters
activities.summary: DSEC-9 has no warp destination of its own. Use any Monria teleporter, choose DSEC9 in the map dropdown at the top right and pick its entry teleporter. Monrian-born avatars may also qualify for Toulan's born starter chain.
steps: Open any Monria teleporter.
Choose DSEC9 in the top-right map dropdown.
Select the DSEC9 entry teleporter; continue with the DSEC-9 file.
rewards: Access to DSEC-9 and its beginner chain (Welcome to the Dark Side)

prereqInfo.note: Partner guides (Sep 2022, last edited Sep 2026) and the October 2026 event post: from any Monria teleporter pick DSEC9 in the drop-down. No other condition is mentioned.

cost.text: No fee mentioned for the local teleport.

score.rationale: Sol's step 4; free local hop to DSEC-9's beginner gear and repeatables.

warnings: This is the same step as 'Enter DSEC-9 from Monria' in the DSEC-9 list.

diagnostics.symptom: DSEC9 is not in the teleporter drop-down
diagnostics.check: Scroll the drop-down list: it is longer than the box and the scroll bar on the right is thin. Virtualsense staff gave this answer in Oct 2024.

activities.title: Shoggoth daily (Sachem Ursa)
activities.summary: Fill the Shoggoth progress bar for Sachem Ursa at DSEC Forensics. Higher maturities move the bar faster. The same kills can advance Codex, plushies and maybe Chapter 1 of the Order.
steps: Take the Shoggoth daily from Sachem Ursa at DSEC Forensics.
Hunt Shoggoths until the progress bar is full; bigger maturities count for more.
Return to Sachem Ursa to turn in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for the Shoggoth hunt.

currencies.name: Daily Token
currencies.note: 1 per turn-in; spend at the Monria Hub token traders.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

score.rationale: First repeatable in Sol's order; stacks with Codex, plushie and Chapter 1 progress.

activities.title: Yog daily (Negated)
activities.summary: Fill Yog progress for Negated, southeast of the DSEC Mining Camp teleporter along the wall. Chapter 2 of the Order can drop independently.
steps: Take the Yog daily from Negated, southeast of the DSEC Mining Camp TP along the wall.
Hunt Yogs until the progress bar is full.
Return to Negated to turn in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for the Yog hunt.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

score.rationale: Second in Sol's order; double tokens and a Chapter 2 chance.

activities.title: Mining daily (Curd)
activities.summary: Curd at DSEC Mining Camp, next to the Repair NPC, gives a mining daily. Pick it up before you start mining. Monria has no mining or hunting tax according to the official page.
steps: Take the daily from Curd next to the Repair NPC at DSEC Mining Camp before mining.
Follow the active mining objective.
Return to Curd to turn in.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

score.rationale: Third in Sol's order; a token for mining you may do anyway, no local tax.

warnings: The exact count or points threshold is pending a field check.
An old 4.2-era token issue with Curd is historical; the 2025 directory still lists the daily.

activities.title: Cultist daily (Colonel Wang)

steps: Take the Cultist daily from Colonel Wang by the stable north of DSEC Military Camp TP.
Hunt Cultists until the progress bar is full.
Return to Colonel Wang to turn in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for the Cultist hunt.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

locations.label: Colonel Wang, DSEC Military Camp stable

score.rationale: Fourth in Sol's order; double tokens and a Chapter 3 chance.

activities.title: Shub daily (Angel)
activities.summary: Angel near the Shub Cavern teleporter gives the Shub daily. It pays the most tokens; take it once you are equipped for Shubs. Chapter 4 of the Order can drop independently.
steps: Take the Shub daily from Angel near the Shub Cavern TP.
Hunt Shubs until the progress bar is full.
Return to Angel to turn in.

cost.text: Ammo and decay for a harder hunt.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

score.rationale: Fifth in Sol's order; best token payout but needs stronger gear.

warnings: Published coordinates for Angel differ by a few units between sources; use the NPC name on arrival.

activities.title: Unlock Tobie's crafting daily
activities.summary: Before the crafting daily opens you must finish Tobie's chain: discover a Monria blueprint, become a local crafter, then reach 100 and 500 successful crafts.
steps: Find Tobie on the second floor of Monria Hub, opposite the Trade Center.
Complete Discover a Monria Blueprint, then Become a Local Crafter.
Make 100 successful crafts, then 500 successful crafts.
Check during the unlock that your blueprint actually counts.
rewards: Access to the repeatable crafting daily

cost.text: Crafting materials and blueprint use; 500 successes can take far more than 500 attempts.

score.rationale: Sixth in Sol's order; the payoff is skill, and reaching 500 successes is costly.

warnings: Tobie's published altitude differs between sources; use the second-floor Trade Center direction.

activities.title: Crafting daily (Tobie, 500 successes)
activities.summary: After the unlock, Tobie's daily asks for 500 successful crafts and pays Engineering skill, not spendable PED. Count your cost per success.
steps: Test on a small batch first that your crafts count (the guide flags manual versus automatic crafting; later players describe different workflows).
Make 500 successful crafts.
Hand in to Tobie.
rewards: 0.75 PED of Engineering skill (not spendable PED)

cooldown.resetNote: 21 h from hand-in per the Everything Guide, about 22 h from turn-in per the mission thread; exact length pending. Set to 22 h so the app does not show it ready early; mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Skill-only reward for a large crafting run; only worth it if you craft anyway.

warnings: Timer conflict: 21 h vs about 22 h in two Virtualsense sources.
Which crafts count automatically is unclear; validate on a small batch.

activities.title: Tame 200 Green Leprechauns (plushie)
activities.summary: Colonel Wang at the stable runs the taming mission: tame 200 Green Leprechauns to earn the plushie and open a repeat.
steps: Talk to Colonel Wang at the stable north of DSEC Military Camp TP.
Tame 200 Green Leprechauns.
Hand in for the plushie; the 50-tame repeat opens.

locations.label: Colonel Wang, DSEC Military Camp stable

score.rationale: Last in Sol's order; opens a small token repeat.

activities.title: Taming repeat (50 Green Leprechauns)
activities.summary: After the plushie, tame 50 more Green Leprechauns for Colonel Wang each cycle.
steps: Take the repeat from Colonel Wang.
Tame 50 Green Leprechauns.
Turn in.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h from turn-in per the Virtualsense mission page. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in or it may show ready later than the game.

locations.label: Colonel Wang, DSEC Military Camp stable

score.rationale: Last in Sol's order; one token per cycle.

activities.title: Spend Daily Tokens wisely
activities.summary: Daily Tokens buy equipment at the token traders on the Monria Hub second floor. Combat and Mayhem traders are separate. Hold tokens until a limited item fits your profession level or plans.
steps: Go to the token trader area on the Monria Hub second floor.
Check current stock and the trade/binding rules.
Buy only when the item matches your level or planned activity.
rewards: Equipment choice from the Daily Token traders

currencies.name: Daily Token
currencies.note: Spent at the Monria Hub token traders; keep until a suitable item is available.

score.rationale: Avoids wasting tokens on gear you cannot use yet.

warnings: Current vendor stock and trade/binding rules need confirming in game.
